expected.subject: flowclient.flowclient.*
expected.justification: ADR-0003: clients reach the single query library only through the language neutral HTTP API; a direct flowclient -> flowmachine import bypasses the single access point

expected.subject: flowapi.flowapi.*
expected.justification: ADR-0003 Decision: 'FlowMachine will be wrapped by an HTTP API.' The wrapper layer must not import the wrapped library directly; they communicate over zmq per ADR-0005

expected.subject: flowapi.flowapi.*
expected.justification: ADR-0004 Decision: 'The FlowKit API will make use of the Quart framework.' — the API layer is built on Quart

expected.subject: flowapi.flowapi.*
expected.justification: ADR-0005 Decision: 'API-backend communication will be via zeromq' — the API side of the IPC channel depends on zeromq

expected.subject: flowmachine.flowmachine.core.*
expected.justification: ADR-0005 Decision: 'IPC in the backend will be mediated by redis' — backend IPC/state code depends on redis

expected.subject: flowapi.flowapi.*
expected.justification: ADR-0006 Decision: 'API authentication and access control will use JWTs.' — the API's auth/access-control surface depends on the JWT machinery (quart_jwt_extended)
